name: Louise Hardwich
original_name: ルイーズ・ハルトヴィック
source:
Louise is confident and popular. He looks cool and calm, but he has a sharp tongue. Although he doesn't mind using flattery to get what he wants, he refuses to do anything that will make him look bad.
